transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling card customer support. My name is Julian. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Julian, I have an issue with a purchase I made online for some speakers that I never actually received.
Agent: I can look into that for you. May I have your full name and the billing zip code on your account?
Customer: Yes, it's Rosa Quintero, and the zip code is 97201.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Quintero. Can you tell me the name of the business and the date the transaction occurred?
Customer: The merchant was Halvorsen Audio, and the transaction went through on September 5th.
Agent: Got it, Halvorsen Audio on September 5th. Did they provide you with any tracking or delivery information for the order?
Customer: Yes, they gave me a tracking link, but when I looked at the delivery details, it shows the package was dropped off at a house on a completely different street.
Agent: Did you receive the package at your home at any point?
Customer: No, I never got them. The delivery photo shows a front porch on Elm Street, but I live on Birch Avenue.
Agent: Have you contacted Halvorsen Audio about the package going to the wrong location?
Customer: I did. They told me that because the package is marked as delivered in the carrier's system, they can't help me.
Agent: Did they offer to send a replacement or open an investigation with the carrier?
Customer: No, nothing. They just said it was marked delivered on their end. And it appeared right on my September 15th statement, exactly thirty days ago today.
Agent: Did you have a chance to contact the delivery service directly about the drop-off?
Customer: I called them, but they said only Halvorsen Audio can submit an inquiry for a misdelivered shipment, so I am just stuck without my order.
Agent: So to make sure I have the facts straight, you ordered speakers from Halvorsen Audio on September 5th, the carrier's tracking indicates the package went to an address on another street, the merchant refused to help because the tracking status says delivered, and you saw the charge on your September 15th statement thirty days ago without ever receiving the speakers.
